newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.85 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.85 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at Tuesday's 9.0 trillion lire 20-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 6.85 percent, compared with 6.88 percent at the previous repo tender on July 14, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.88 percent against 6.94 percent at the last repurchase pact for 8.5 trillion lire and 18 days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on August 4. The Bank said it received 40 bids of which 25 were met in full and five in part.
